blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We propose a novel view synthesis tool for galaxies based on Gaussian Splatting (GS). Unlike RGB data, where GS has achieved success, galaxy observations consist of multi-band signals from a massive number of bodies, contain complex patterns of cross-band interactions, and capture light propagation in highly heterogeneous media. As a result, the underlying physical process poses great challenges in model representation and optimization, which have not been investigated in existing research. To this end, we propose a physically inspired Gaussian Splatting method, GalaxyGS, which is equipped with physically meaningful components that capture both the energy emission mechanism of different astronomical bodies and the light propagation between them. In the absence of directly comparable baseline methods, we adopt a wide range of possible alternative approaches. Comparisons conclusively demonstrate that GalaxyGS is better in accuracy and physical fidelity across datasets and metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个基于高斯白板(GS)的星系新颖的视图合成工具. 与GS已经取得成功的RGB数据不同,银河系观测由来自众多天体的多波段信号组成,包含复杂的跨波段相互作用模式,并在高度多样化的介质中捕捉光传播. 因此,基本的物理过程对模型的表达和优化提出了巨大的挑战,而在现有的研究中还没有对此进行调查. 为此,我们提出一种具有物理灵感的高斯电镀法GalaxyGS,它配备了物理上有意义的组件,既能捕捉不同天文体的能量排放机制,又能捕捉它们之间的光传播. 在没有可直接比较的基准方法的情况下,我们采取了一系列可能的替代办法。 比较最终表明,GalaxyGS在准确性和物理上对数据集和衡量标准更加忠实。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 18 ] has become a versatile foundational component for 3D reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping [ 17 ] , autonomous driving [ 37 ] , and 3D representations in generative models [ 39 ] . So far, its applications have often focused on RGB and RGB-D data, sometimes with additional appearance or geometric information such as texture, lighting, and surface normals [ 25 ] . In other words, the synthesized novel view is often restricted to the visible spectrum of human eyes. Recently, 3DGS has been extended to data that go beyond the visible spectrum, such as thermal imaging [ 26 ] and hyperspectral reconstruction [ 36 ] . Our research also extends 3DGS into a new domain, multi-band galaxy novel view synthesis, where the signals cover a wide range of wavelengths with light propagation through complex and heterogeneous media. Given sparse multi-band images of a galaxy, we reconstruct galaxies by predicting multi-band images at unseen viewpoints, extending 3DGS into a scientific research tool for astronomy.
blocks.zh: 3D高斯平板(3DGS) [18] 已经成为一个多功能的基础构件,用于3D重建,同步本地化和绘图[17],自主驱动 [37],以及基因模型中的3D表示 [39]. 迄今为止,其应用经常以RGB和RGB-D数据为主,有时还有额外的外观或几何信息,如纹理,照明等,并有地表常态[25]. 换句话说,被合成的小说取景经常被限制在人眼的可见光谱上. 最近,3DGS被扩展至超过可见光谱的数据,如热成像[26]和超光谱重建[36]. 我们的研究还将3DGS扩展至一个新的域,多波段银河系小说视野合成,其中的信号通过复杂多变的介质以光传播来覆盖广泛的波长. 由于银河系的多波段图像稀少,我们通过在未见的视点预测多波段图像来重建星系,将3DGS扩展为天文学的科学研究工具.

blocks.en: Galaxy reconstruction poses three coupled representational and optimization challenges, which demand a fundamental modeling innovation rather than a naive adaptation of existing 3DGS research. The first challenge is the heterogeneous media. A galaxy observation contains mixed multi-band signals from stars and dust of various sizes and properties. This gives compound signals which, if not untangled well, severely compromise novel view synthesis. These components have distinct emission mechanisms, manifested as different energy distributions across wavelengths, e.g . ultraviolet-to-near-infrared (UV-NIR), mid-infrared (MIR), and far-infrared to submillimeter (FIR/submm) ranges [ 6 ] . The energy of stellar emission is concentrated in the UV-NIR range, while dust emission extends across the MIR and FIR/submm ranges [ 10 ] . This is significantly different from existing methods where stellar and dust emission mechanisms are rarely explicitly considered, even in those designed for spectral signals [ 36 , 28 ] and astronomy [ 23 , 15 , 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 银河系统重建提出了三个既具有代表性又具有优化性质的挑战,这需要一种基本的创新模式,而不是对现有的3DGS研究进行天真的调整。 第一个挑战是各种媒体。 一个星系观测包含由恒星和大小和性质不同的尘埃所发出的多波段混合信号. 这给出了复合信号,如果这些信号不解好,就会严重地损害到新颖观点的合成. 这些部件具有不同的排放机制,表现为波长不同的能量分布,例如紫外线到近红外线(UV-NIR)、红外线中红外线(MIR)和远红外线到子毫米(FIR/submm)范围[6]。 星状排放的能耗集中在紫外线-NIR范围,而尘埃排放则延伸到MIR和FIR/summ范围[10]. 这与现有方法大相径庭,即使为光谱信号[36、28]和天文学[23、15、31]设计的方法也很少明确考虑星体和尘埃排放机制。

blocks.en: The immediately following challenge is the complex light propagation in heterogeneous media. Stellar emission is strong but attenuated by dust through absorption and scattering, and absorbed energy heats the dust, which further re-emits energy mainly in the infrared range, producing a thermal dust continuum [ 35 ] . At the same time, there are small dust grains that also absorb and re-emit energy, contributing strongly to emission in the MIR range [ 10 ] . Existing 3DGS research, including spectral models, often simplifies the propagation process without modeling the behaviors of different media during propagation [ 28 ] . In our case, not only do we need to model emission and its propagation, but we also aim to make them physically meaningful, e.g . attributing the correct amount of energy to different components when learning from mixed signals.
blocks.zh: 紧接其后的挑战,是在各种媒体上传播复杂的光线。 斯特拉尔排放量很大,但通过吸收和散射被尘埃所缓解,所吸收的能为尘埃加热,而尘埃主要在红外范围内进一步再活化出能,产生出热尘相通[35]. 同时,也有一些也吸收和再放电能的小粉尘谷物,对MIR范围的排放做出了很大的贡献 [10]. 现有的3DGS研究,包括光谱模型,往往简化了传播过程,而没有在传播过程中模拟不同媒介的行为[28]. 就我们而言,我们不仅需要模拟排放及其传播,而且还要力求使它们具有实际意义,例如,在从混合信号中学习时,将正确的能量量分配给不同的部件。

blocks.en: Last but not least, heterogeneous media and complex light propagation jointly impose challenges on optimization, which needs to accurately synthesize views and simultaneously untangle the signals and attribute them to corresponding components. Such optimization cannot be achieved by simple stochastic gradient [ 18 ] or sampling methods [ 19 ] alone, without a representation that distinguishes emission from attenuation, as shown later.
blocks.zh: 最后但并非最不重要的是,各种媒体和复杂的光传播共同给优化带来挑战,需要准确综合各种观点,同时解开信号并把它们归为相应的组件。 单靠简单的分层梯度[18]或取样方法[19]是无法实现这种优化的,如下文所示,没有区分排放和衰减的说明。

blocks.en: To jointly address these challenges, we propose a new 3DGS method named Galactic Gaussian Splatting (GalaxyGS). GalaxyGS is physically inspired and consists of two key elements: structured primitives and staged optimization. We first create three Gaussian fields in 3D space: a stellar emission field, a dust attenuation field, and a dust emission field. We design three types of primitives for these fields. Next, the first two fields jointly model stellar emission and its attenuation, while the last field captures the dust re-emission. These physically inspired fields explicitly model light propagation and assign distinct emission and attenuation contributions to the observed multi-band signals. Having addressed the representational challenges, we find that jointly training all components easily suffers from local minima. This involves not only a highly nonconvex optimization problem but also solution ambiguity, i.e . multiple physical models can give the same observation [ 9 , 21 ] . Therefore, we propose a new physically inspired strategy for staged optimization of the fields.
blocks.zh: 为了共同应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种新的3DGS方法,取名"银河高斯平板"(GalaxyGS). 银河 GS具有物理灵感,由两个关键要素组成:结构化原始和相相优化. 我们首先在3D空间创建出三个高斯地:一个星相排放地,一个尘分衰减地,一个尘分排放地. 我们为这些田地设计了三种原始种. 接下来,前两个字段联合模拟了星相出气及其衰减,而后一个字段则捕捉出尘埃再出气. 这些物理启发的领域明确模拟了光的传播,并为观测到的多波段信号分配了独特的排放和减弱作用。 在解决了代表性挑战之后,我们发现,联合培训所有组成部分都很容易受到当地微弱的影响。 这不仅涉及高度非曲线优化问题,还涉及解决方案模糊性,即多个物理模型可以给出相同的观测[9,21]. 因此,我们提出一个新的具有物质灵感的战略,以便分阶段优化实地。

blocks.en: We evaluate GalaxyGS on two datasets: Auriga [ 16 ] and TNG50 [ 7 ] . Since there are no GS methods for galaxy reconstruction, we adapt six closely related methods, which cover a wide range of representations and optimization strategies. Evaluation conclusively demonstrates the performance of GalaxyGS across galaxies of different types, formation mechanisms, etc . GalaxyGS universally outperforms the best baseline method by 31.4 % 31.4\% in reconstruction accuracy and 80.2 % 80.2\% in physical fidelity. Our contributions include:
blocks.zh: 我们在两个数据集上评价GalaxyGS:Auriga [16]和TNG50 [7]. 由于没有用于银河系重建的GS方法,我们调整了六种密切相关的方法,它们涵盖了广泛的表达和优化策略. 评价最终证明了银河系GS跨不同类型星系的性能,形成机制等. 银河 GS在重建准确度方面普遍比最佳基线方法高出31.4%,在身体忠诚度方面高出80.2%。 我们的贡献包括:

blocks.en: • the first 3DGS method for multi-band galaxy novel view synthesis, to the best of our knowledge. • a physically inspired 3DGS representation that explicitly models energy emission mechanisms. • a physically inspired light propagation model for 3DGS. • a staged optimization strategy to enable 3DGS to disentangle mixed signals.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Multi-band representations. Multi-band view synthesis extends appearance modeling beyond RGB through wavelength-dependent radiance or shared spectral features. HS-NeRF [ 5 ] conditions radiance on wavelength, while ThermalGaussian [ 26 ] couples RGB and thermal Gaussians through multimodal regularization. Using shared spectral features, HyperGS [ 36 ] renders in a pretrained autoencoder’s latent space and decodes the result into spectra. MS-Splatting [ 28 ] instead decodes shared per-Gaussian features into band radiance before rendering. For direct spectral modeling, DD-HGS [ 30 ] conditions spherical harmonic coefficients on wavelength and denoises rendered spectra with diffusion. Material-based approaches give a physical interpretation. UnMix-NeRF [ 32 ] models diffuse spectra as nonnegative mixtures of learned material spectra, and SpectralGaussians [ 34 ] separates spectral reflectance and illumination for relighting. These methods advance spectral modeling from appearance prediction toward physical interpretation, but do not explicitly distinguish objects with different emission mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 多段表示. 多波段视图合成通过波长依赖光度或共享光谱特征将外观模型延伸至RGB之外. HS-NERF [5] 条件在波长上发光,而热能Gausian [26] 情侣RGB和热能高斯人则通过多模式正规化. HyperGS [36] 利用共享的光谱特性,将结果解码为光谱。 MS-Splating [28] 取而代之的是,在渲染前将共享于每个高斯人的特性解码为波段光度. 就直接光谱模型而言,DD-HGS[30]条件波长的球形口腔系数和凹陷使光谱随扩散而成. 以材料为基础的方法提供了实际解释。 Unmix-NERF [32] 模型扩散光谱作为所学材料光谱的非阴性混合物,光谱Gausians [34] 分离光谱反射和发光来再点亮. 这些方法将光谱模型从外观预测推进到物理解释,但没有明确区分具有不同排放机制的物体。

blocks.en: Neural rendering with complex media. The observed image depends on source spectra and light propagation through the scene. FitSKIRT [ 8 ] estimates parametric stellar and dust distributions by comparing SKIRT radiative-transfer simulations with galaxy images. Astronomical neural renderers incorporate domain-specific propagation. BH-NeRF [ 23 ] recovers emission near black holes using gravitationally bent rays, while SuNeRF [ 15 ] models solar-coronal emission and absorption. For small-body surfaces, AstroSplat [ 31 ] instead ties Gaussian intensity to surface orientation and sunlight through planetary reflectance models. SeaThru-NeRF [ 24 ] and SeaSplat [ 38 ] similarly separate scene appearance from wavelength-dependent attenuation and backscatter in water. These neural renderers model specialized propagation effects, but not the distinct emission mechanisms and attenuation that coexist in galaxy images.
blocks.zh: 用复杂的介质进行神经渲染. 所观测到的图像取决于源光谱和光线在现场的传播. FitSKIRT [8]通过将SKIRT的辐射-转移模拟与银河系图像进行比较,估计了参数星等和尘埃分布. 天文神经成像器包含特定域的传播. BH-NERF [23]利用重力弯曲射线来回收黑洞附近的排放,而SUNERF [15] 则模拟了太阳-日冕排放和吸收. 对于小体表面,AstroSplat [31] 转而通过行星反射模型将高斯强度与地表取向和阳光联系起来. Seathru-NERF [24]和SeaSplat [38] 类似地将场景外观与波长依赖性衰减和向后散落于水中. 这些神经成像器模型是专门传播效应,但不是银河系图像中共存的独特的排放机制和衰减机制。

blocks.en: Optimization. Other than gradient-based optimization with adaptive cloning and splitting [ 18 ] or sampling [ 19 ] , existing research uses bespoke optimization for different scenarios. Under sparse views, LGDWT-GS [ 33 ] adds global and patch-wise image wavelet losses to regularize scene fitting. 3DSatellites [ 3 ] couples Gaussian reconstruction with camera-pose estimation. Estimating physical properties introduces a different difficulty, because material and illumination changes can compensate in the rendered image [ 21 ] . GS-IR [ 25 ] organizes this estimation in stages, reconstructing geometry and caching occlusion before fitting material properties and illumination. In our research, separating mixed radiative signals requires controlling compensation between emission and attenuation.
blocks.zh: 优化. 除了通过适应性克隆和分化[18]或采样[19]进行梯度优化外,现有的研究用途是针对不同情况进行点名优化。 在稀有的视野下,LGDWT-GS[33]增加了全球和补丁图像波浪损失,使场景配置规范化. 3DSatellites [3]夫妇高斯重建 相机持有量估计. 估计物理属性带来了不同的困难,因为物质和发光变化可以在所渲染的图像中补偿[21]. GS-IR [25] 分阶段组织这一估计,重建几何学和收缩闭塞,然后再配上材料特性和发光. 在我们的研究中,分离混合辐射信号需要控制排放和衰减之间的补偿。

blocks.en: Galaxy observations are more complex than the RGB data in standard GS, and novel view synthesis for galaxies requires physical fidelity on top of visual realism. As a result, cross-band interactions need to be explicitly considered and physically meaningful measures of light distribution are required, none of which is needed in standard GS.

blocks.en: Next, different astronomical bodies show distinctive behaviors in light emission and attenuation. Their emissions can span the whole spectrum but concentrate on different band groups, shown in Fig. 1 left. First, stellar emission dominates the UV-NIR group. Its spectral shape varies with stellar age and metallicity [ 2 ] . Hotter stars, for example, emit a greater fraction of their light at shorter wavelengths. Dust absorbs and scatters stellar light, causing dimming. This intensity of the dimming depends on the optical depth [ 35 ] and the wavelength, also described by a function called an extinction curve [ 11 ] . Furthermore, dust is heated by absorbed light and then emits in the IR groups, where small grains contribute strongly in the MIR group, while larger grains dominate the FIR/submm group [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 接下来,不同的天文体在光的放出和衰减方面表现出了独特的行为. 它们的排放可跨越整个范围,但集中于不同的波段组,如图1所显示。 首先,星体排放在UV-NIR集团中占主导地位. 其光谱形状随星系时代和金属性而异 [2]. 例如更热的恒星以更短的波长放出更分量的光. 尘埃会吸收并散开星光,引起暗淡. 这种凹陷强度取决于光学深度[35]和波长,也由一种叫"灭绝曲线"[11]的函数所描述. 此外,尘埃被吸收光所加热,然后在IR组中发出,在IR组中,小粒在MIR组中贡献很大,而较大的粒则占据了FIR/子组 [10].

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We propose GalaxyGS, a physically inspired model of light propagation in galaxies ( Fig. 1 ). It represents stellar emission, dust attenuation, and dust emission with separate Gaussian fields, fitted through a specially designed optimization. One key design is to constrain the learning of different Gaussian fields within physically meaningful spaces spanned by appropriate basis functions.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用银河GalaxyGS(图1),这是一种在星系中进行光传播的物理启发模型。 它代表星相排放、尘埃衰减和尘埃排放,通过专门设计的优化装置安装在单独的高斯场上。 一个关键的设计是限制在具有适当基础功能的物理意义空间内学习不同的高斯场.

blocks.en: 4.1 Gaussian Fields
blocks.zh: 4.1 高斯战地

blocks.en: We model a galaxy as a distribution of stars and dust, and explicitly represent emission and attenuation with three Gaussian fields: 𝒢 = 𝒢 star ∪ 𝒢 dust ∪ 𝒢 att , \mathcal{G}=\mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{star}}\cup\mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{dust}}\cup\mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{att}}, (1) where 𝒢 star \mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{star}} , 𝒢 dust \mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{dust}} , and 𝒢 att \mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{att}} represent stellar emission, dust emission, and dust attenuation, respectively. Stars and dust have different spatial distributions and radiative roles [ 12 ] . Stars are direct sources of strong emission. Dust emission only happens when it absorbs stellar emission, i.e . an indirect source of emission, and this light absorption causes attenuation. Dust attenuation is complex and depends on the spatial distribution of the dust with respect to stars and cameras. We use Gaussians parameterized by a mean 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} , covariance 𝚺 \boldsymbol{\Sigma} , view-independent emission vector 𝐞 ∈ ℝ C \mathbf{e}\in\mathbb{R}^{C} for its C C bands, and opacity α \alpha for all three fields, and they differ only in how they model emission 𝐞 \mathbf{e} and opacity α \alpha .

blocks.en: 4.2 Physically Inspired Gaussians

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Stellar Gaussians
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 斯泰拉尔·高西亚人

blocks.en: Stellar emission dominates the UV-NIR range, but naive learning is unlikely to give good results, because fitting 3D Gaussians from 2D images is ambiguous [ 18 , Sec. 5.1] , i.e . different sets of Gaussians can produce the same view. This might not be an issue if only visual realism is the goal, while in GalaxyGS, we aim to enforce physical realism.
blocks.zh: Stellar放出物在紫外线-NIR范围内占据了主导地位,但天真的学习不太可能产生好的结果,因为从2D图像中安装出3D高斯人是模棱两可的[18, 第5.1条],即不同的高斯人组可以产生同一种观点. 如果目标只是视觉现实主义,这也许不是一个问题,而在GalaxyGS中,我们的目标是执行物理现实主义。

blocks.en: A key observation is that stellar emission is featured by its energy distribution across bands. The cross-band covariance is not random, but has patterns that strongly depend on the age and metallicity of the stellar populations [ 2 ] . This means that the covariance patterns can serve as a physically meaningful space to represent stellar emission. Therefore, we use it to establish a basis constraining the learning.
blocks.zh: 一项关键观察是,星系排放的特点是其跨波段的能分. 跨波段相通性不是随机的,而是具有强烈地依赖于星系种群的年龄和金属的规律[2]. 这意味着共变模式可以作为一个物理上有意义的空间来表示星相出射. 因此,我们利用它来建立制约学习的基础。

blocks.en:
Specifically, we collect n n stellar emission spectra 𝐗 ∈ ℝ n × C \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times C} with a mean 𝐗 ¯ \mathbf{\bar{X}} from galaxies varying in age and metallicity [ 2 ] . We then apply Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and retain the top K K eigenvectors as the columns of 𝐁 ∈ ℝ C × K \mathbf{B}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times K} .
For a band group with C C bands, the emission vector 𝐞 ∈ ℝ C \mathbf{e}\in\mathbb{R}^{C} is parameterized as 𝐞 \displaystyle\mathbf{e} = softplus ⁡ ( a ) ​ 𝐬 , \displaystyle=\operatorname{softplus}(a)\mathbf{s}, where ​ 𝐬 \displaystyle\text{where }\mathbf{s} = softmax ⁡ ( 𝐗 ¯ + 𝐁𝐳 ) , 𝐳 = 𝜷 ⊙ tanh ⁡ ( 𝐮 ) , \displaystyle=\operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\mathbf{\bar{X}}+\mathbf{B}\mathbf{z}\right),\mathbf{z}=\boldsymbol{\beta}\odot\tanh(\mathbf{u}), (4) where a a is a learnable scalar and 𝐮 ∈ ℝ K \mathbf{u}\in\mathbb{R}^{K} is a learnable vector. 𝜷 ∈ ℝ > 0 K \boldsymbol{\beta}\in\mathbb{R}_{>0}^{K} is predefined e.g . 0.1.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Dust Gaussians
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 灰尘高斯人

blocks.en: Dust absorbs stellar radiation and re-emits across two band groups, MIR and FIR/submm, corresponding to different dust grain properties and heating [ 10 ] . MIR features from small grains vary in strength, while the shape of the FIR/submm thermal spectrum varies with dust temperature.
blocks.zh: 尘埃会吸收星状辐射,并重聚于两个波段组别,即MIR和FIR/submm,对应不同的尘粒属性并加热 [10]. 小粒子的MIR特征在强度上有所不同,而FIR/亚mm热谱的外形则随尘温而变化.

blocks.en:
To make the learning physically inspired, we propose a strategy similar to that for stellar emission. We collect multi-band images from outside our data, referred to as reference images. For each band group, we sample n n pixels with positive intensities across its C C bands, giving 𝐗 ref ∈ ℝ n × C \mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{ref}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times C} .
We then apply PCA to each group’s 𝐗 ref \mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{ref}} , giving the PCA bases of MIR and FIR/submm, respectively. Finally, we learn the emission of both groups using Eq. 4 .
Note that the means and covariances of the dust Gaussians are shared between MIR and FIR/submm, but each group has its own PCA scores 𝐳 \mathbf{z} and amplitude parameter a a , allowing its spectral shape and emission amplitude to vary independently. The sharing of means and covariances is because the MIR and FIR/submm signals are mainly from the small and large grains in the same dust. In other words, the dust is a continuum with randomly distributed particles (small and large grains). Empirically, independently learning both with separate means and covariances leads to ill-conditioned optimization.

4.3 Staged Optimization
blocks.zh: 4.3 阶段优化

blocks.en: With all types of Gaussians specified, we can train the model. However, different types of Gaussians can compensate for one another when fitting the data. E.g . weak emission plus weak attenuation gives a similar result to strong emission plus strong attenuation. We therefore propose a three-stage optimization below.
blocks.zh: 在指定了各种高斯人后,我们可以训练模型. 然而,不同类型的高斯人可以在匹配数据时相互补偿. 例如,低排放加弱衰减产生类似的结果,即高排放加强衰减。 因此,我们提议在以下三个阶段进行优化。

blocks.en:
Stellar and dust emission dominate different band groups. Therefore, we first fit the stellar emission field and dust emission field independently. With the stellar and dust PCA bases fixed,
each field learns its Gaussian means, covariances, opacity, PCA scores, and amplitudes together. During this learning stage, we adapt Gaussian positions and counts through the relocation, growth, and covariance-scaled position perturbations of 3DGS-MCMC [ 19 ] .

blocks.en: Datasets. We use SKIRT-Auriga [ 16 ] and TNG50 [ 7 ] for evaluation. Auriga uses zoom simulations to study individual galaxies similar in mass to the Milky Way [ 13 ] . We select ten galaxies, each with 17 views. We use 14 views for training and 3 for testing. Each view provides a 50-band image, spanning 0.15 0.15 - 1244 ​ μ ​ m 1244\,\mu\mathrm{m} with 21 bands in the UV-NIR group, 9 in the MIR group, and 20 in the FIR/submm group. The FIR/submm group includes the 22 22 - 24 ​ μ ​ m 24\,\mu\mathrm{m} band range. Training and evaluation use 512 × 512 512\times 512 images. TNG50 simulates a population of galaxies within a large region of the universe. We select ten galaxies, each with 14 views. We use 11 views for training and 3 for testing. Each view provides a 27-band image spanning 0.7 0.7 – 4.8 ​ μ ​ m 4.8\,\mu\mathrm{m} , with all bands assigned to the UV-NIR group. Training and evaluation use 256 × 256 256\times 256 images. Note that in both datasets, the number of views is small, i.e . a typical sparse view setting.

blocks.en: Baselines. Since there are no directly comparable baselines, we compare GalaxyGS with six methods with adaptations for galaxy data. These baselines include TensoRF-VM-MB [ 4 ] , FeatSplat-MB [ 27 ] , MS-Splatting [ 28 ] , LGDWT-GS-MB [ 33 ] , and 3DSatellites-MB [ 3 ] . In addition, we also augment the original 3DGS [ 18 ] to 3DGS-MB, where we use degree-three spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients per band.

blocks.en: Metrics. We assess two aspects for evaluation, i.e . , reconstruction quality and physical fidelity. For all metrics, lower values indicate better results.

To evaluate reconstruction quality, we use NMSE to measure reconstruction errors in pixel intensity relative to each band’s GT scale. At each pixel, we also compare spectral similarity using the spectral angle mapper (SAM) [ 22 ] , SAM w \mathrm{SAM}_{w} .
For physical fidelity, we use the flux error E flux E_{\mathrm{flux}} to compare each band’s total flux with GT. Additionally, the SED error E SED E_{\mathrm{SED}} compares the relative band flux distribution. To validate the spatial difference in astronomical images, we employ the Sliced Wasserstein-1 distance ( SW 1 \mathrm{SW}_{1} ) to measure the predicted and GT light distributions [ 20 ] . To measure how far the light extends, we compare the difference between the predicted and GT images’ half-light radii, the semimajor axes of ellipses enclosing half of each image’s total light [ 1 ] , denoted as E R e E_{R_{e}} .
We also compare dust mass differences E M d E_{M_{\mathrm{d}}} in the FIR range, estimated from the predicted and GT images. We evaluate this on Auriga, as TNG50 lacks data in the FIR range.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Quantitative comparison
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 数量比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares GalaxyGS with six baselines on Auriga and TNG50, where GalaxyGS achieves the lowest mean error on all metrics. While on visual similarity metrics such as NMSE, GalaxyGS already universally improves the results, its improvements in physical fidelity metrics are even more prominent, often by large margins, which is particularly useful in demonstrating that GalaxyGS is not only seeking visual similarity in reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了GalaxyGS在Auriga和TNG50上的6个基线,其中GalaxyGS在所有衡量标准上的平均误差最低。 虽然在NMSE等视觉相似度测量标准上,GalaxyGS已经普遍改进了结果,但其物理忠诚度测量标准的改进甚至更加突出,常常是很大的差分,这特别有助于证明GalaxyGS不仅在重建中寻求视觉相似度。

blocks.en: On Auriga, GalaxyGS achieves an SW 1 \mathrm{SW}_{1} of 1.429 1.429 , compared with 4.686 4.686 for the next-best LGDWT-GS-MB, which employs wavelet losses to preserve spatial structure and has an error 227.9 % 227.9\% higher than ours. Our separate stellar and dust emission fields allow wavelength-dependent spatial distributions, compared with LGDWT-GS-MB’s single field. In addition, we also achieve an E SED E_{\mathrm{SED}} of 0.068 0.068 , compared with 0.140 0.140 for the next-best TensoRF-VM-MB, whose error is 106.9 % 106.9\% higher than ours. While TensoRF-VM-MB predicts all bands from a factorized field, our reference PCA bases constrain cross-band intensity variations within each emission field.
blocks.zh: 在Auriga上,GalaxyGS实现了SW 1\mathrm{SW}_{1}的1.429 1.429,而次佳的LGDWT-GS-MB则达到了4.686 4.686,它利用波浪损失来保持空间结构,并且有一个比我们高227.9%227.9%的误差. 与LGDWT-GS-MB的单一领域相比,我们单独的星系和尘埃排放场允许波长相依的空间分布。 此外,我们还实现了ESED E_{\mathrm{SED}}为0.068 0.068,相较于下等TensoRF-VM-MB的0.140 0.140,其出错比我们高出106.9%. 虽然TensoRF-VM-MB预测来自一个因子化场的所有波段,但我们的参考PCA基础限制每个排放场的跨波段强度变化。

blocks.en: On TNG50, our method achieves an E SED E_{\mathrm{SED}} of 0.044 0.044 , compared with 0.150 0.150 from the next-best method 3DSatellites-MB, whose error is 244.5 % 244.5\% higher than ours. While 3DSatellites-MB extends its Gaussian representation to multiple bands, our model explicitly separates dust attenuation from stellar emission. This enables wavelength-dependent attenuation along each viewing ray, accounting for both intensity reduction and changes in spectral shape.
blocks.zh: 在 TNG50 上, 我们的方法实现了 E SED E_{\mathrm{SED}} 0.044 0. 虽然3DSatellites-MB将其高斯语的表示扩展到了多个波段,但我们的模型明确区分了尘埃衰减与星体排放. 这使得每个取景射线都能够进行波长依赖衰减,既考虑到强度的降低,又考虑到光谱形状的变化。

blocks.en: The aggregate metrics above cannot directly demonstrate the scale or prominence of the difference. Therefore, we also show qualitative results. For Auriga, we show four bands from one test view of galaxy AU-26 in Fig. 2 . In AU-26, TensoRF-VM-MB and 3DSatellites-MB recover the bright disk but completely miss the infrared light above it. In contrast, FeatSplat-MB recovers dust emission, but underestimates the bright disk. All other baseline methods are in between. GalaxyGS retains the bright disk together with much of the surrounding emission. The outer infrared emission of AU-26 provides a second example. LGDWT-GS-MB recovers the bright center, with disconnected patches in the surrounding infrared light. 3DSatellites-MB produces a compact center with little of the extended structure. GalaxyGS retains the compact center and the wider infrared details.
blocks.zh: 以上汇总的衡量尺度不能直接显示差异的规模或突出程度. 因此,我们还显示了质量成果。 对于Auriga,我们从一个测试视图中显示四个波段的银河AU-26在Fig. 2. 在AU-26中,TensoRF-VM-MB和3DSatellites-MB回收了亮光光盘,但完全错过了上面的红外光. 相形之下,FeatSplate-MB回收了尘埃排放,但低估了亮盘. 所有其他基准方法都在两者之间。 银河 GS保留了亮盘与周围大部分排放. AU-26的外红外辐射提供了第二个例子。 LGDWT-GS-MB恢复了明亮的中心,周围的红外光有断开的补丁. 3DSatellites-MB产生一个紧凑的中枢,其扩展结构很少. 银河 GS保留了紧凑中心和更广泛的红外线细节.

blocks.en: The three-color TNG50 views show both bright structures and surrounding diffuse emission. 3DGS-MB and LGDWT-GS-MB are best among the baselines but still produce colored artifacts around bright regions, while 3DSatellites-MB oversmooths the diffuse emission, reducing the visibility of individual bright structures. In contrast, GalaxyGS preserves the curved central structure in galaxy 2877 and the diagonal distribution of bright regions in galaxy 7732, while retaining the surrounding diffuse emission.
blocks.zh: 三色 TNG50 视图显示明亮的结构以及周围的散射. 3DGS-MB和LGDWT-GS-MB在基线中最好,但仍在亮地区域周围出产有色文物,而3DSatellites-MB则过度流出,降低了单个亮地结构的能见度. 相形之下,GalaxyGS保留了银河系2877中的曲线中心结构与银河系7732中的亮相区域的对角分布,同时保留了周围的散射.

blocks.en: We further evaluate physical fidelity using a controlled scene. We simulated a galaxy where we have ground truth for emission and attenuation separately, so that predictions can be compared with the true emission of astronomical bodies. Figure 3 compares the 3D light distributions and cumulative flux along the viewing direction. In the top panels of Fig. 3 , GalaxyGS produces distributions more similar to GT. In contrast, 3DGS-MB and LGDWT-GS-MB produce fragmented distributions shifted toward the observer, while 3DSatellites-MB concentrates flux within a narrow depth range. In the bottom panels of Fig. 3 , the curves show the percentage of total band flux contributed by objects closer to the observer across depths. Our cumulative flux profiles better match the gradual increase observed in GT, indicating a more physically accurate reconstruction of the spatial distribution of light.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion, Discussion, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论、讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We presented GalaxyGS, the first 3DGS method for multi-band galaxy novel view synthesis. By turning 3DGS into a physically inspired formulation, GalaxyGS represents stellar emission, dust attenuation, and dust emission, models light propagation and attenuation, and trains via staged optimization. Experiments demonstrate that GalaxyGS outperforms all baselines, often by large margins.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了GalaxyGS, 第一个3DGS方法 多波段银河系小说视图合成。 GalaxyGS通过将3DGS转化为一种具有物理灵感的配方,代表了星状排放、尘埃分解和尘埃分解、光照分解和分解模型,以及通过分级优化的火车。 实验表明,GalaxyGS的绩效往往大于所有基线,往往差幅很大。

blocks.en: However, while the physical priors constrain the spectra of individual fields, GalaxyGS does not explicitly link the starlight absorbed by dust to its infrared emission. Also, reconstruction requires multiple views of the same galaxy to constrain its 3D structure, limiting its application to galaxies observed from a single direction. Future work will improve the physical fidelity by coupling dust absorption and emission and explore structural priors that could enable single-view reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 然而,虽然物理前传限制了单个字段的光谱,GalaxyGS并没有明确地将被尘埃所吸收的星光与其红外辐射联系起来. 另外,重建需要同一个星系的多视角来限制其3D结构,将其应用限制在从单一方向观测到的星系上. 今后的工作将通过将粉尘吸收和排放结合起来来提高物理上的忠诚度,并探索能够进行单视重建的结构前科。
